summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, lore-based destinations, a social mall and solo tutorial spaces. `templates/player.js` composes shared player behaviors; place sims generate and tick local worlds, with Level 13 combining story-varied flats, hall residents and hostiles, and a shared cat-bodied NPC appearance system.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0/Lobby maze; sim lays ecology, generated moments, safe rooms and routes including the Level 0.2 door.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with authored shops/escalators and simulated staff; Rico's platform routine and Bonus Line boarding cooperate.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial route.
places/level01 (3D) - Zenith Station: station, breach, doors, bots, hazards and recorder quest.
places/level1, level2, level21, level3, gamma (3D) - Habitable Zone/M.E.G. camp, Pipe Dreams, Locked, Electrical Station and Base Gamma; place sims add specialized layout, residents and crossings.
places/level4, level5, level6, level7, level10 (3D) - Office, Hotel, drowned house, sea/Fort Surrender and lake destinations; local sims own specialized environments and routes.
places/level11 (3D) - Infinite City; generated city blocks, connected market/shop/transit streets, residents and crossings, with incremental scene build and city tick.

places/level12, places/level13 (3D) - Matrix leads to The Boiling Frogs; Level 13 has furnished flats, Floor 283 Free Home Project residents/quest, hostile tenants and lurker, and Level 12/main crossings.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input mappings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generated/ticked simulation.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title, creation, arrival and tutorial routing.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player state/actions, aiming camera and third-person toggle.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/level0-moments.js; places/level1/sim.js + scripts/lib/level1.js - seeded maze moments and Level 1 layout/camp/doors.
places/level02/sim.js + scripts/lib/level02.js + scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - Level 0.2 shell, office/basement, collapse, lift, stairway and Fresh Paint connection.
places/level11/sim.js + scripts/lib/level11-city.js - Level 11 city/street generation and city activity; sim also lays shops/vaults and runs shared threshold/sign dressing.

places/level13/sim.js + scripts/lib/level13.js + level13-furnish.js/level13-dress.js/level13-foes.js/level13-people.js - apartment shell, furnishings, hall traces, enemy slots and Floor 283 residents/quest tick.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/data/preload.yml + scripts/lib/preload-next.js - solo room IDs/names and destinations, plus door/model manifest for player proximity preloading; includes l12-to-l13 and l13-to-l0.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/data/weapons.yml - common loot, containers, item definitions, rarity and weapon variants.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js - parametric door geometry/motion and deterministic Level 3 paired wall-hatch layout.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js and scripts/lib/sign-style.js + scripts/sign-geo.js - shared crossing clues and per-place/id generated sign boards.
scripts/lib/quest-route.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js + scripts/lib/quests.js - crossing graph/objectives and common quest state; Level 12→13 and Level 13→main are explicit exits.
scripts/lib/data/l02-props.yml - dimensioned Tripo prop catalog for Level 0.2; scripts/lib/data/cat-wardrobe.yml - shared Tripo garments used by clothes.js/critter-model.js.
scripts/lib/level13.js - Level 13 floor-plan dimensions, APTS and flat/hall lookup shared by sim and furnishing, dress, foes, people and quest systems.

scripts/lib/dialogue.js + dlg-*.yml + scripts/lib/npc-starters.js - authored conversation trees/context choices; dlg-level13.yml supplies Floor 283 resident lines; shops.yml/npc-voices.yml key trade stock and voice types.
notableExports: scripts/lib/thresholds.js - dressThresholds; scripts/threshold-geo.js - threshold geometry/material builders.
scripts/lib/quest-route.js - nextQuestExit; scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - questMark; scripts/lib/quests.js - MAX_TRACK, TINT, PLACE_NAMES, qid, setQuest, endQuest, tracked, toggleTrack.
scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - QUESTS02, setRemodStep, gotFresh, remodelChoices, handleDialogueQuest02, placeFreshener, freshenerAt, FRESH_BODY, pickPlaced, nearFresh.
scripts/lib/level02.js - Level 0.2 geometry/door helpers; scripts/climb.js - onInput, update.

scripts/lib/level13.js - H, HALL, T, UNIT, HALLS, SPAWN, EXIT0, APTS, apt, aptAt, roomAt, inHall; level13-people.js - SEATS, layPeople; level13-dress.js - layDress; level13-foes.js - SLOTS, homeOf, foeSpec, layFoes; level13-furnish.js - layFurnish.
scripts/l13-foes.js - update; scripts/l13-fridge.js - updateSchedule, rollFridge; places/level13/sim.js - cadence, LETH, tick.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, weaponAim, onInput, hitTarget, HOLO/holoEnd and throwable callbacks.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment (including fresh), needs, combat, access, appearance, saved position and carried tapes; scripts/lib/forgive.js owns NPC grudge entries in player state.
scripts/lib/quests.js - player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; quest handlers own quest-specific state; dina-quest.js owns dinaQ, dinaDiary, dcut and seeds the-way-back.
scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - player.state.remodQ, l02got, fresh, capnAsk and capnFailed plus Fresh Paint quest/HUD/payout/reputation; player.js reads the nearby-freshener sanity effect.

scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js own kick cooldowns and carry/held target session; scripts/lib/loose.js + breakables.js own loose prop/wreck and breakable state, including place.state.gone and wall breakage/timestamps.
scripts/lib/knock.js + stats.js - foe weight/attributes and down/stagger outcomes; enemy managers own AI and sneakTarget.

Place sims own generated-scene and migration markers, including Level 0.2 phase/lift/caseLandAt and Level 7 fortPathV/catV; Bonus sim owns staff/Rico migration; Level 13 sim writes player.state.leth13 from per-player dwell timing.
scripts/l13-foes.js owns Level 13 foe memory/dead-slot timestamps; tenant/lurker objects own combat health, drops and corpse state; scripts/l13-fridge.js owns fridge inventory/refill timestamps.

Level 13 furnishing, dressing and people helpers own separate place-state layout/version markers; people lays l13p-* residents/quest props and calls questTick; level13-quest.js owns player.state.l13q, l13locket, l13route and l13end.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb, interact, grab/kick, build, inventory, combat, social, hub, camera and quest behaviors.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → player.js ballistics and weaponAim.
scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js solo room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to hub/home and maintain roomHop/save-place state; Bonus Line boarding is a separate crossing routine.
Fresh visit → main-menu.js; START routes to intake or Bonus, wardrobe close to intro/tutorial0; menuOpen drives menu UI and solo pause scales place time; hub UI routes Bonus/home destinations.

places/bonus/sim.js attaches scripts/rico.js to bonus-rico; Rico walks platform stops, yields while directly talked to and pauses while hub owns sceneUntil for boarding; boarding clears sceneUntil at end.

scripts/interact.js opens scripts/talk.js → dialogue.js selects dlg-*.yml including dlg-level13.yml; npc-starters.js adds contextual/quest choices, talk validates checks and dispatches quest handlers, then voices.js/hear.js gate speech per actor.

scripts/talk.js aimed ranged weapon or forward contact → authored drawn/close reaction bark and NPC state.socialReaction; scripts/meg-agent.js reads the signal, plays gesture/hit response and re-dresses stale bodies, swapping legacy human NPC bodies to cat bodies.
scripts/climb.js scans tagged ladder objects and grabs from movement toward the rungs (or E at the foot); it owns the local climb session and moves/releases the player along the ladder.
interact.js loot search → loot.gateItems → items/weapons roll; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; focus → player.state.focus → loot/talk/shop UI.

places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/level02.js lay the Level 0 door → scripts/level-door.js crosses to level02#l02-from-l0 or main#main-from-l02; l02-back stamps place.state.emptyAt for Level 0.2 sim reset and salvage flow.

places/level12/sim.js lays l12-to-l13 → scripts/level-door.js crosses to level13#l13-from-l12; Level 13 sim lays arrival and l13-to-l0 to main; quest-route.js exposes both crossings to quest-mark.js/nextQuestExit.

Level 13 sim calls layFurnish/layFoes/layPeople/layDress; furnishing reads level13.yml model sizes and story positions for flats, TV/static and clutter; people reads l13-people.yml, lays residents/quest keepsake and ticks quest state; generic container UI and l13-fridge.js handle fridge stock/restock.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus scenes + bonus data/sim + mall shopper/salon scripts - authored mall and counter behavior; sim lays staff and Rico, whose platform schedule and Bonus Line boarding are separate cooperating routines.
scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction scripts - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild flow.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js and prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametrically generated doors/storage parts with eased motion and legacy prop migration.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js + participating place sims, alongside sign-style.js/sign-geo.js - shared threshold dressing and per-place/per-id sign-board styles.
places/level01/sim.js + Zenith geometry, breach, hatch, bot and hazard scripts - Zenith Station environment and interactive systems.

places/level3/sim.js + level3-details-geo.js + lib/level3-hatch.js + l3-hatch*.js + scripts/l3-line.js - tiled Electrical Station detail, paired steel hatches and animated belt boxes varied by line layout/state.

Level 13: level13-furnish.js + level13.yml place story-varied flats and authored clutter through shared model placement; level13-dress.js + l13-dress.yml fit hall traces/notes/doors; level13-foes.js and l13-foes.js manage configured foe slots/AI; level13-people.js lays Floor 283 residents/quest props.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + npc-looks.yml + critter-model.js + cat-wardrobe.yml + mat-catskin.js + scripts/critter.js + meg-agent.js - deterministic species/look and clothing tokens, Tripo wardrobe attachments and NPC dressing; written or rolled human NPC appearances now use cat bodies.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js, scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - debug-room pads/layout after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/l3-line.js is attached by places/level3/sim.js; the older uploaded l3-assembly-line-2 model remains unreferenced by active line placements.
migrationNotes: Threshold dressing version is V=7 in scripts/lib/thresholds.js; upgrades clean/rebuild thr-tagged objects delayed until colliders stand. Preserve thrSeen/thrTry/thrDone/thrV; sign-style only restyles eligible shallow UI boxes.

Door transfers: carryAcross records xferTo only for local place links with a # marker and crosses carryId/nearby heldBy objects, rejecting room/world and Bonus destinations; Level 1 BACK uses backV destroy-and-respawn migration.

Level 3 hatchV=3 rebuild destroys old l3-hatch-* objects; hatchAt deterministically shares each wall's door across its two faces. Level 3 lineV=2 replaces legacy line-model instances with three Tripo stations and animated belt boxes.

Level 0.2 sim is V=21 and rebuilds l02-* generated roots; preserve phase/lift and caseLandAt state, column/debris tags, 15-second empty reset and delayed collapse. Reception and rebuilt crew stations place desk-top notes/tools at dimensioned positions.

Level 7 fortPathV=6 lowers l7-ft-ramp by 0.12 m; catV=1 refits existing L7_NPCS in place. Level 13 shell V=1 and 1s sim use per-player in-memory STAY time: 45 s to onset, 180 s full, cools over 20 s outside; preserve player.state.leth13 accumulation.

Level 13 helper layouts version independently: furnishing V=4 rebuilds l13f-* from model sizes/story positions (including counter clutter); people PV=3 relocates l13p-keepsake onto the a8 counter; preserve each subsystem's place-state markers. Hall Lurker's bath mode gives a dragged victim the full bathMs to escape; tenant throw cadence/damage come from level13.yml.
